note: Tables: no note describes the room behind the door, and the adventure holds a room table. The GM rolls it with roll_table instead of inventing the room.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: At the far end of the toll-house corridor there is one more door, shut, with a bar of light under it.

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.

lore.title: Toll-house rooms
lore.content:
Rooms in the toll-house. Roll when the player opens a room no note describes.

## Room (1d6)
1. A cold ledger room, shelves of damp toll books
2. A guard barracks, three bunks and a cold brazier
3. A kitchen with a pot still warm
4. A strongroom with its door ajar
5. A chapel to the Pim saints, candles lit
6. A bare cell with a single chair

npcs.name: Odrell Pim
npcs.description: Round-shouldered innkeeper of the Kettle & Rook. Fond of gossip, evasive about his cellar.

playerLine: I open the last door in the corridor and step in. What is this room?
